verdict.rationale: The 01's own docs say assistants can execute code, browse the web, manage files and control third-party software through an Open Interpreter server that executes commands. That is the raw ability to act across apps. There is no evidence that multi-step tasks spanning several apps actually finish reliably without supervision. missing for 10: documented autonomous multi-step task chaining, evidence on reliability and error recovery without user intervention, hands-on or independent reports of cross-app tasks completing unattended.
